input: Unpack each captured packed.f32 bit-exactly to AoS in the same physical base order. POST live set and FP32 bytes are identical across modes; PRE replay includes its published tombstones, not pending buffer.
numeric: Unchanged native getPivotDisTiled distance arithmetic, key=result/10000 + local_node_slot*100, thrust::sort_by_key(thrust::device), native nodeSplit and child sizes. No invented ID secondary key. Capture actual input order and exact key ties.
intervention: Only replace selected middle physical row with an admitted PRE pivot row at requested early levels. No input-order swap, partition-boundary change, distance modification, or forced deeper decision.
correspondence: Root corresponds to PRE root. At deeper requested levels, match PRE and current partitions by unique mutual maximum overlap of immutable occurrence membership. Ties or non-mutual maxima have no correspondence. No numeric node-ID correspondence. Missing matched PRE pivot falls back to native. Record each requested/admitted/fallback and overlap.

conditional_extensions.C2: two processes only if C1 clearly helps or divergence is already rapid in levels 0-1
conditional_extensions.C3: two processes only if C2 leaf churn <=50% or absolute reduction >=30 percentage points versus C0; require both rebuilds for campaign promotion

stop: If any PRE/C0 replay differs in order, active nodes (including all TN bytes), empty flags, leaf membership, pivots, or topology: STOP before any intervention. No C4+, freeze-all, service trace replay, performance claims, tuning, or mechanism design.
validity: Every physical row and live occurrence appears exactly once; complete leaf coverage; leaf sizes 1..20; exact 10-way contiguous child coverage; pivot ownership in parent partition; finite native keys and sortedness.
metrics: exact canonical leaf and common-live-object churn versus PRE and C0
selected split-pivot survival by decision level, not inherited TN.pid level
rank drift and decile crossings under explicit membership correspondence
exact distance-key ties and tied-pair order changes

gate.go: monotonic dose response and C2 reduction >=30 percentage points on both rebuilds
gate.strong_go: C2 or C3 churn <=20% with sharply higher pivot survival on both
gate.root_no_go: C1 churn >=90% and little pivot/partition preservation
gate.early_cascade_no_go: all admitted tested early interventions remain >=90% churn; unrun deeper dose stays unknown

scope: structural causal diagnostic only; no query correctness, sanitizer stress, latency, throughput, or production admission claim
rollback: No keeper edits. Stop only owned process group on contamination/timeout; retain failed evidence. Do not signal foreign processes or alter GPU settings.
